name: Advance one real production turn and explicitly bind only a new generation three spy

condition.code: local p=Players[0]; local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and b and type(b.ThirdSpyBind)=='function'

steps.code: local s=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.ThirdSpyStatus(); assert(s.progressed and not s.bound and s.mapCount==0,'third production must be pending before a real turn'); return 'THIRD_PRODUCTION_PENDING'

condition.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.thirdLast=='ERROR_ATTEST' or b.thirdLast=='ERROR_ADOPT' then error(b.thirdLast) end; return b.thirdProductionStatus=='PRODUCTION_PENDING' or b.ThirdSpyStatus().bound

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if not b.ThirdSpyStatus().bound then return 'THIRD_PRODUCTION_PENDING' end; return b.RetryLivingSpy()
